ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with a low global contrast ratio; high-intensity pixels are localized to discrete surface marks and distal tips, occupying less than 15% of the total fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity base across both lobes; high-intensity (white) clusters concentrated at the extreme lateral tips; multiple discrete high-intensity circular nodes (rings) distributed irregularly across the dark central and peripheral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, sharp V-shaped median notch at the central convergence with an estimated interior angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations forming a jagged, non-linear boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetrical sweep with a slight upward concavity on the inferior edges, transitioning to a sharp convex curve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible collection of approximately 25-30 circular high-contrast ring-shaped clusters (rosettes) scattered across the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, low-contrast linear pixel disruptions oriented diagonally across the mid-region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (barnacle attachment marks) and dense white encrustations localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-intensity (white) pigmentation patches limited strictly to the extreme outer edges and tips, contrasting sharply with the dark fluke body.
